title: Repo0: Design-Driven Zero-to-All Code Generation
abstract: arXiv:2608.19854v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language model agents have made substantial progress in code generation, yet most existing systems assume a predefined repository architecture. This assumption does not hold in zero-to-all code generation, where an agent must construct an entire software project directly from natural-language requirements while maintaining a modular repository architecture throughout development. We present Repo0, a continuous structural evolution framework for zero-to-all code generation. Repo0 maintains an explicit architectural state instantiated as a Dual-Directed-Acyclic-Graph (Dual-DAG), consisting of a requirement-level DAG, a component-level DAG, and their alignment relation. Starting from natural-language requirements, it iteratively evolves component boundaries through structural actions guided by modularity metrics until structural convergence, after which the converged architecture guides test-driven development code generation. translated_title: Repo0：设计驱动的从零到全代码生成
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.19854v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：大型语言模型代理在代码生成方面取得了显著进展，但大多数现有系统假设预定义仓库架构。这一假设在从零到全代码生成中不成立，在这种场景下，代理必须直接从自然语言需求构建整个软件项目，并在整个开发过程中保持模块化仓库架构。我们提出了Repo0，一个用于从零到全代码生成的连续结构演化框架。Repo0维护一个显式的架构状态，实例化为双有向无环图（Dual-DAG），包括需求级DAG、组件级DAG及其对齐关系。从自然语言需求开始，它通过由模块化度量引导的结构操作迭代演化组件边界，直到结构收敛，之后收敛的架构指导测试驱动的开发代码生成。我们进行了评估。
tldr: Repo0提出了一种基于双有向无环图（Dual-DAG）的连续结构演化框架，通过模块化度量引导架构迭代收敛，实现从自然语言需求直接生成完整模块化软件项目，填补了零到全代码生成中架构假设的空白。
en_tdlr: Repo0 proposes a continuous structural evolution framework based on Dual-DAG, iteratively converging architecture via modularity metrics to generate complete modular software projects directly from natural-language requirements, filling the gap of architecture assumptions in zero-to-all code generation.
